description.zh: 使用配置的模型完成任务。

tools.name: agent.run
tools.description: Run a goal in the application's ongoing conversation, retaining earlier work and messages. scope={} allows discovery across plugins; scope fields restrict this execution's calls to those exact values. Use agent.message to add instructions while running.

tools.name: agent.message
tools.description: Continue the application's ongoing conversation. While running, add a requirement or correction without resetting progress, scope or executing operations. While idle, begin execution with global tool access and the existing conversation and working context.

tools.name: agent.status
tools.description: Read agent progress and the last outcome.

tools.name: agent.environment
tools.description: Read the saved goal, progress note and local conversation.

tools.name: agent.stop
tools.description: Stop execution and cancel its pending operation before taking over. Conversation and work are retained for the next instruction.
